mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM book WHERE book_key = #{bookKey})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book (book_key, title, author, status) VALUES (#{bookKey}, #{title}, #{author}, #{status})
INSERT INTO book_paragraph (book_id, page_id, paragraph_index, source_order, content) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{pageId}, #{paragraphIndex}, #{sourceOrder}, #{content})
INSERT INTO book_image (book_id, page_id, image_order, file_path) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{pageId}, #{imageOrder}, #{filePath})
